competitiveTarget: Beat portal city-directory pages — a real editorial destination with verified per-city photography and a live regional pulse, not a link farm.
note: Experience System Geo hub v3.2 (Family 4 rework, 2026-06-10). Built after Matt's 'ultra thin' verdict on the v3.1 index. Structure: live region pulse hero (getRegionPulse) -> featured city editorial rows (full-width, hairline rules, alternating photo/content, VERIFIED cityHero() photography, live per-city stat bands from getMarketPulseCitySnapshots with geo_snapshot_mv fallback, one honest editorial sentence per city, links to city page + searches + open houses) -> other-areas compact ledger -> navy search CTA. CollectionPage + ItemList + Breadcrumb JSON-LD. EngagedSection telemetry on every section. No tile walls.
